2607.14152.title: "Trust Junk" Leads to Unjustified Support for Highly Discriminatory Predictive Models
2607.14152.paper_summary: The persuasive power of data visualizations can go awry: for instance, in an explainable AI (XAI) context, visualizations can produce over-trust of predictive models. In this paper, we use a crowdsourced study to show that providing accurate (but superfluous or irrelevant) data in a model explanation can, in fact, result in unjustified trust and other positive beliefs about a model, even when the model is patently discriminatory and unfair. Our results suggest that XAI designers and developers need to consider the implicit or explicit rhetorics of their work, and beware of the potential of visualizations to imbue models with unearned trust.
2607.14152.paper_summary_zh: 數據可視化的說服力可能會出錯：例如，在可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）背景下，可視化可能會導致對預測模型的過度信任。在本文中，我們使用一項眾包研究來表明，在模型解釋中提供準確（但多餘或無關的）數據，實際上可能會導致對模型的不當信任和其他正面信念，即使該模型顯然具有歧視性和不公平性。我們的結果表明，XAI 設計師和開發者需要考慮他們工作的隱含或明確修辭，並警惕可視化可能使模型獲得不當信任的潛力。
